scheme_name: Grant Of Retention Scholarship to Scheduled Caste Girl Students
other_conditions: Must be a native of Puducherry or have resided there continuously for at least five years.
Must be studying in classes I to V in a government or recognized private institution in Puducherry.
Scholarship will be cancelled for misconduct or if obtained by false statement.
Scholarship is retained only while the student continues satisfactory studies and gets promotion each year.
benefits_summary: ₹1,000 per student per year (₹100 per month for 10 months) for classes I‑V.
